headline: Field Restore
body: Local-first audio restoration for field recordings.
imageNote: Image: Actual Field Restore interface, with the spectrogram and product name visible.

headline: Keep your source recording untouched.
body: - Build a reversible edit chain
- Compare Original and Edited while listening
- Export creates a separate file; it does not replace the source
imageNote: Image: Actual Original/Edited comparison from the app.

headline: Open WAV, FLAC, or MP4 audio.
body: - Drop a supported recording into the app
- Import and edit audio locally on your device
- MP4 video stays unchanged; its audio is exported as WAV
imageNote: Image: The app’s real import panel or drop area.

headline: See sound across time and frequency.
body: - Inspect the spectrogram and listen to the recording
- Select a passage for focused listening and analysis
- Compare the original with the edited result
imageNote: Image: Actual Field Restore spectrogram with a selected passage.

headline: Shape the edit chain around the recording.
body: - Gain, EQ, and Fade In/Out adjust level and tone
- Low Rumble Removal and Hum Removal target steady interference
- Wind Removal follows changing low-frequency interference
- Processing stays stereo-linked by default
imageNote: Image: Actual edit-chain view showing the available modules.

headline: Use focused tools for noise and local defects.
body: - Noise Reduction: automatic estimate or a steady noise-only sample
- Click & Pop Removal: short, isolated defects
- Short Sound Repair: selected time-frequency areas
- Region Attenuation and Ambient Patch: localized edits
imageNote: Image: Actual module controls or selected spectrogram area.

headline: Tune Wind Removal—and listen for wanted low sounds.
body: - Set Detection, Reduction, Crossover frequency, and Smoothing
- Starting defaults: 72% Reduction · 140 Hz Crossover · 50% Smoothing
- Higher crossover can reduce wanted bass and low calls
- Compare with the module bypassed; no setting guarantees complete wind removal

headline: Compare measurements as estimates, not verdicts.
body: - Review true-peak estimate, integrated loudness, loudness range, and max short-term level
- Check PLR and separate Left/Right LBPR readings for stereo
- Compare full recordings or a selected passage
- Browser-local estimates are not certified meter readings

headline: Keep project information on your device.
body: - Audio processing, playback, and export run locally; audio is not uploaded for server processing
- Save edits, trim, markers, and notes in this browser
- Back up project metadata separately; keep the original recording with it
- Prepare the app online for offline use
imageNote: Image: Actual Project or offline-setup panel.

headline: Export a new WAV and its restoration report.
body: - 32-bit float WAV at the source sample rate and channel count
- The report lists the edit chain and signal statistics
- MP4 input exports edited audio only; the video remains unchanged
Try Field Restore: larslentz.github.io/field-restore/
